lessons.title: There is, there isn't: ಇದೆ, ಇಲ್ಲ

decks.name: Vowels

decks.name: Conjuncts and anusvara
decks.desc: Doubled letters, the common ottakshara, ರ್ before a consonant, the anusvara before each kind of letter, and the virama in English loans

decks.name: Greetings and courtesy
decks.desc: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನೀವು and ನೀನು, thank you, sorry, yes and no, OK, goodbye

decks.name: About me
decks.desc: Name, where you are from and live, work and study, languages, with the verb endings for I and you

decks.name: Family and people
decks.desc: Family on both sides, older and younger siblings, the respect plural, counting people with ಒಬ್ಬರು and ಇಬ್ಬರು

decks.name: Numbers and money
decks.desc: Numbers to 100, ನೂರು and ಸಾವಿರ, rupees and dollars, ಎಷ್ಟು? and the human counting forms

decks.name: Food and drink
decks.desc: Filter coffee, idli, dosa, rice, ragi mudde and bisibele bath, ordering at a darshini and eating at home

decks.name: Home and daily things
decks.desc: Rooms and objects, plurals in -ಗಳು, everyday adjectives, what is and is not there

decks.name: Time, days and routine
decks.desc: Clock time, days of the week, a day in the present tense, yesterday and tomorrow

decks.name: Likes and free time
decks.desc: Films, cricket, music, reading, likes with ನನಗೆ … ಇಷ್ಟ, and what you are doing right now

decks.name: Getting around
decks.desc: Places with -ಗೆ and -ಅಲ್ಲಿ, from and with, left and right, autos, buses and the metro

decks.name: Shopping and the market
decks.desc: Prices, a little bargaining, clothes and vegetables, this one or that one, cheaper and bigger

decks.name: Health and help
decks.desc: Polite requests, feeling sick, the doctor and the pharmacy, must, may and can, asking for help

decks.name: Questions and connectors
decks.desc: Question words, -ಆ questions, and ಮತ್ತು, ಆದರೆ, ಯಾಕೆಂದರೆ, ಅದಕ್ಕೆ

decks.name: Traps for English speakers
decks.desc: Calques, the ನನಗೆ pattern, the three words for no, negation, and words that fool you
